name: The Root Readers
prompt: Lift one immense banyan-like root system out of the ground on ivory trestles. Delicate glass sleeves enclose bright root tips. Researchers stand beneath the suspended tangle, gently feeding different soils into its transparent ends.

name: A Seed Learns the Wind
prompt: Set a long indigo wind tunnel open on one side like a flute cut lengthwise. Downy seeds hang at different heights in the air stream. Researchers catch them in gold thread hoops on rolling ladders.

name: The Graft Supper
prompt: Train five thick fruit branches into a low pentagonal dining table. At each corner a different graft blooms across a visible bandage. Botanists share a meal while carefully tying young shoots from neighbouring species together overhead.

name: The Herbarium Unpressed
prompt: Stand enormous translucent specimen sheets in a zigzag, their living ferns emerging from the flat silhouettes. A gardener gently releases one frond from its linen ties. Thin green shadows overlap across pale pink paper.

name: The Pollen Weighhouse
prompt: Balance a pair of vast shallow gold dishes on a fine black beam. One holds a featherlike mound of turquoise pollen; researchers ferry tiny counterweights onto the other in teaspoons. A silk canopy is rolled back for the weighing.
